It'd be best to introduce this algorithm like

> When [the WebSocket connection is established] for a `WebSocketStream` _stream_, the user agent...:

and then use _stream_ throughout.

What I've tried is to make `WebSocket.prototype.close` convert missing values to "null" using the special value "missing". The fact that the WebIDL standard provides no definition for "missing" makes me uncomfortable.

This is slightly weird, as RFC 6455 likes to Capitalize it's operations: https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc6455#section-6.1

I'd rather follow RFC 6455's practice when referring to its operations, if you don't object too strongly.

Possibly it's best to just delete "if it is not already"?
